text: The dialog has an accessible-name localization ID, a linked image/* file input and a separate alert banner. The markup keeps the keyboard-cropping FIXME, and the actual drag/corner movers use mouse events. This source supports the picker and status-control changes while preserving the remaining crop-control limit. No keyboard, accessibility-tree or screen-reader run occurred.
title: Contact-photo selection uses native controls while cropping retains mouse handlers
